chapters.label: Live: World Cup 2024
chapters.text: The 2024 Futsal World Cup, in Uzbekistan. Spain play New Zealand. Catela is Spain’s ala, a winger. He scores three goals in the second half, and Spain win seven one!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: An ala plays on the wing, close to the touchline. This is how he does it: he passes inside, then keeps running. He sprints round the outside, gets it back in space and shoots!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again. Pass, run round the outside: the defender cannot follow both!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: pass, then keep moving. Futsal is all about pass and move!
